# Integration design before product
Deposit is the B05 guarantee aggregate, not a funds ledger. Internal custody references real H3 verified Allocation purpose deposit and its original payment/reconciliation portions; no new balance or reserve engine. External custody never manufactures those objects. Guarantee returns reuse b05_refund_movements and b05_refunds as their canonical restitution facts; Deposit keeps links and delivery/retention facts. Material guarantee basis is independent of Cancellation Right. Existing Refund contractual path remains unchanged; a narrow guarantee registration path delegates to Deposit authority/conditions and uses the same movement identity and T07 transaction. Sensitive guarantee resolution uses existing TTE proposal/decision/reservation/final check and exact content, no new approval store. Current operational scope and historical catalogue/terms stay distinct; reviewers compare source/version/conditions explicitly. No domain-pure evaluation persists implicitly.
